_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: Angry Birds was not Rovio's first game. It was not their tenth, or their thirtieth.

beats.name: Niklas Hed, Jarno Vakevainen and Kim Dikert
beats.role: Three university students who started a company called Relude after winning a Finnish demo competition. It was renamed Rovio two years later.

beats.text: Rovio had made 51 games and was close to bankruptcy when it built its 52nd, Angry Birds, in eight months.
beats.note: That count comes from Rovio's own company history page, not a rounded up legend.

beats.lead: The pigs have two origin stories
beats.text: It is commonly believed the pig enemies were inspired by the 2009 swine flu pandemic, which was in the news while the game was made.
beats.note: Designer Jaakko Iisalo has disputed this, saying the pig design traces back to drawings he made at around age 10, long before the outbreak.

beats.lead: One claim is easier to check than the other
beats.text: The 51 games and eight month build time both come from Rovio's own company history page.
beats.note: The pig origin is less settled. It survives mainly as a disputed claim, so it is presented here as contested rather than confirmed.

beats.line: Fifty one failures and eight months stand between a near bankrupt studio and the birds.
